descriptions.zh: 某架飞船坠毁在了这颗小行星的表面。飞行器的残骸仍能在撞击坑里找到。
descriptions.en: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.

sections.zh: 某架飞船坠毁在了这颗小行星的表面。飞行器的残骸仍能在撞击坑里找到。
sections.en: A vessel of some kind has crashed into the surface of this asteroid. Wreckage from the craft can still be found within the impact crater.

descriptions.zh: 这颗小行星的成分与周围的小行星大不相同。它的起源可能与小行星带上的其他小行星截然不同，应该进行更进一步的研究。
descriptions.en: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星的成分与周围的小行星大不相同。它的起源可能与小行星带上的其他小行星截然不同，应该进行更进一步的研究。
sections.en: The material composition of this asteroid differs significantly from its neighbors. It likely has a different origin than the other bodies of this asteroid belt, and should be investigated more closely.

descriptions.zh: 这颗小行星的表面散步着金属碎片。这些碎片大多看起来属于许多不同的飞船。
descriptions.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星的表面散步着金属碎片。这些碎片大多看起来属于许多不同的飞船。
sections.en: The surface of this asteroid is littered with metallic debris. Most of it appears to originate from starships of many different designs.

descriptions.zh: 未知来源发出的强大能量辐射使得这颗小行星在众多同类中十分扎眼。
descriptions.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

sections.zh: 未知来源发出的强大能量辐射使得这颗小行星在众多同类中十分扎眼。
sections.en: Strong energy emissions of an unknown origin make this asteroid stand out from the rest of its peers in this crowded asteroid field.

descriptions.zh: 一个通往这颗小行星内部的对接舱坐落在其表面的一个小坑里。舱口似乎被密封过，但之后被微陨石撞开了。
descriptions.en: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.

sections.zh: 一个通往这颗小行星内部的对接舱坐落在其表面的一个小坑里。舱口似乎被密封过，但之后被微陨石撞开了。
sections.en: A small docking hatch leading to the interior of this asteroid is visible at the rim of a small crater on its surface. The hatch was likely concealed once, but it has since been exposed by micrometeorite impacts.

descriptions.zh: 这颗小行星最近被小行星带里的一颗行星撞击了。其表面留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，同时轨道也有所偏离。
descriptions.en: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星最近被小行星带里的一颗行星撞击了。其表面留下了一个巨大的撞击坑，同时轨道也有所偏离。
sections.en: This asteroid recently suffered an impact from another body within the asteroid belt, which resulted in a slightly changed orbit and a massive crater on the surface.

descriptions.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
descriptions.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

sections.zh: 这颗小行星的轨道上运行着一个小型空间站。似乎已经废弃。
sections.en: A small space station of some kind has been built in a stable orbit around this asteroid. It appears deserted.

descriptions.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
descriptions.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

sections.zh: 我们接收到这颗小行星内部有着某种生命迹象。强烈建议深入调查。
sections.en: We are picking up life signs coming from somewhere within the interior of this asteroid. This definitely warrants a closer investigation.

descriptions.zh: 传感器回波表明这颗庞大的气态巨行星的大气层内存在不明物体。
descriptions.en: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.

sections.zh: 传感器回波表明这颗庞大的气态巨行星的大气层内存在不明物体。
sections.en: Sensor echoes have indicated the presence of some kind of unidentified object deep within the atmosphere of this gas giant.

descriptions.zh: 一颗小型卫星正环绕这颗气态巨行星运行，这颗小卫星可能蕴藏大量矿藏。需要进行一次彻底的调查，对开采行动的可能性进行研究。
descriptions.en: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.

sections.zh: 一颗小型卫星正环绕这颗气态巨行星运行，这颗小卫星可能蕴藏大量矿藏。需要进行一次彻底的调查，对开采行动的可能性进行研究。
sections.en: One of the small moonlets orbiting this gas giant has been identified as a promising mining site. A more thorough survey will have to be conducted to determine whether a mining operation would be feasible or not.

descriptions.zh: 这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部检测到了生命迹象。这是否表明是有生物圈存在？
descriptions.en: Life signs have been detected coming from inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could it indicate the presence of some kind of biosphere?

sections.zh: 这颗气态巨行星的大气层内部检测到了生命迹象。这是否表明是有生物圈存在？
sections.en: Life signs have been detected coming from inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could it indicate the presence of some kind of biosphere?

descriptions.zh: 可以看到这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中发生了大风暴。进行深入研究可能十分有价值。
descriptions.en: Massive storms are visible in the upper atmosphere of this gas giant. It might be worth the effort to study them in more detail.

sections.zh: 可以看到这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中发生了大风暴。进行深入研究可能十分有价值。
sections.en: Massive storms are visible in the upper atmosphere of this gas giant. It might be worth the effort to study them in more detail.

descriptions.zh: 某种未知结构正漂浮在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中。似乎是用到了空气静力学的原理来维持漂浮。
descriptions.en: Some kind of unknown structures are floating in this gas giant's upper atmosphere. They appear to be using aerostatic lift to remain buoyant.

sections.zh: 某种未知结构正漂浮在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气中。似乎是用到了空气静力学的原理来维持漂浮。
sections.en: Some kind of unknown structures are floating in this gas giant's upper atmosphere. They appear to be using aerostatic lift to remain buoyant.

descriptions.zh: 有一个小型货舱被遗落在了这颗气态巨行星的上方空间。它被行星的重力所捕获，最终将被拖入其大气。
descriptions.en: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.

sections.zh: 有一个小型货舱被遗落在了这颗气态巨行星的上方空间。它被行星的重力所捕获，最终将被拖入其大气。
sections.en: A small cargo pod has been left to drift in space above this gas giant. It has been captured by the planet's gravity well, and will eventually be pulled into its atmosphere.

descriptions.zh: 这颗气态巨行星周围存在大量碎片。大部分来自各种规格的失事星舰。
descriptions.en: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.

sections.zh: 这颗气态巨行星周围存在大量碎片。大部分来自各种规格的失事星舰。
sections.en: There is a significant amount of debris in orbit around this gas giant. Most of it appears to come from long lost starships of various configurations.

descriptions.zh: 巨大的撞击坑表明某种大型物体曾撞击[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
descriptions.en: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.

sections.zh: 巨大的撞击坑表明某种大型物体曾撞击[Root.GetPlanetMoon]表面。
sections.en: A colossal impact crater hints that something big collided with the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] once.

descriptions.zh: 我们短暂地接收到了非比寻常的能源示数，发射源来自[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。这有可能是我们的系统出现了故障，也有可能预示着我们发现了不得了的东西。
descriptions.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

sections.zh: 我们短暂地接收到了非比寻常的能源示数，发射源来自[Root.GetPlanetMoon]。这有可能是我们的系统出现了故障，也有可能预示着我们发现了不得了的东西。
sections.en: We briefly detected some unusual energy readings emanating from this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. It might have been a glitch in our systems, or it could be a sign of something more.

descriptions.zh: 我们在调查[Root.GetPlanetMoon]时偶然接收到了一个微弱的外星信号。信号源似乎是轨道上的一个小物品。信号没有包含信息——难道是遇险应答器吗？
descriptions.en: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?

sections.zh: 我们在调查[Root.GetPlanetMoon]时偶然接收到了一个微弱的外星信号。信号源似乎是轨道上的一个小物品。信号没有包含信息——难道是遇险应答器吗？
sections.en: By chance, we stumbled upon a faint alien signal during the survey of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be a small object in orbit. The signal contains no message - could it be a distress transponder?

descriptions.zh: 一枚12级小行星围绕着[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道运行。这枚小行星的轨道实在太过稳定了，难以相信是自然形成的。
descriptions.en: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.

sections.zh: 一枚12级小行星围绕着[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道运行。这枚小行星的轨道实在太过稳定了，难以相信是自然形成的。
sections.en: A class-12 asteroid orbits this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The small planetoid's orbit appears far too stable for its presence to be a natural occurrence.

descriptions.zh: 一艘被遗弃的飞船漫无目的地漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上空。巨大的帆耸立于舰体之上，这表明其动力是太阳能。
descriptions.en: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.

sections.zh: 一艘被遗弃的飞船漫无目的地漂浮在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上空。巨大的帆耸立于舰体之上，这表明其动力是太阳能。
sections.en: An abandoned ship has been left to drift aimlessly above this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The massive sails protruding from its hull suggest that it relied on solar power to function.

descriptions.zh: 尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大气中含有剧毒成分，且气压极高，但仍然能检测到强烈的生命迹象。
descriptions.en: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.

sections.zh: 尽管[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的大气中含有剧毒成分，且气压极高，但仍然能检测到强烈的生命迹象。
sections.en: Despite the toxic content and high pressure of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]'s atmosphere, strong life signs have been detected coming from its surface.

descriptions.zh: 乍看上去，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]似乎不能支持生命的存在，但我们探测到了从冰冻的地表以下发出的生命信号。
descriptions.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

sections.zh: 乍看上去，[Root.GetPlanetMoon]似乎不能支持生命的存在，但我们探测到了从冰冻的地表以下发出的生命信号。
sections.en: At first glance this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] does not seem capable of supporting living beings, but nevertheless we have detected life signs emanating from somewhere beneath its frozen surface.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]贫瘠的不毛之地下方探测到了生命的迹象。到底是怎样的有机体才有可能生存在那里面呢？
descriptions.en: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?

sections.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]贫瘠的不毛之地下方探测到了生命的迹象。到底是怎样的有机体才有可能生存在那里面呢？
sections.en: We have detected life signs coming from somewhere beneath the barren and lifeless surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. What manner of organism could possibly live there?

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上存在着大量的飞船残骸。这有可能是某次大型舰队行动遗留下来的。
descriptions.en: A large amount of ship debris can be found in orbit around this [Root.GetPlanetMoon], possibly the remnants of some kind of massive fleet action.

sections.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]的轨道上存在着大量的飞船残骸。这有可能是某次大型舰队行动遗留下来的。
sections.en: A large amount of ship debris can be found in orbit around this [Root.GetPlanetMoon], possibly the remnants of some kind of massive fleet action.

descriptions.zh: 此世界的上方静静地飘着一座远古轨道船坞。它在战争中严重受损，多个部位缺失。
descriptions.en: An ancient orbital shipyard drifts in silence above this world. It has suffered significant battle damage, and entire sections of the facility are missing.

sections.zh: 此世界的上方静静地飘着一座远古轨道船坞。它在战争中严重受损，多个部位缺失。
sections.en: An ancient orbital shipyard drifts in silence above this world. It has suffered significant battle damage, and entire sections of the facility are missing.

descriptions.zh: 这个寸草不生的世界似乎曾居住着的前太空时代文明。其城市的废墟还在该行星表面随处可见。
descriptions.en: This toxic and lifeless world appears to have once been inhabited by a moderately advanced pre-space civilization. The ruins of their cities are still strewn across the surface.

sections.zh: 这个寸草不生的世界似乎曾居住着的前太空时代文明。其城市的废墟还在该行星表面随处可见。
sections.en: This toxic and lifeless world appears to have once been inhabited by a moderately advanced pre-space civilization. The ruins of their cities are still strewn across the surface.

descriptions.zh: 该星球的地表上有着巨大的裂痕，从其图案判断，不可能是自然形成的。从轨道上看，这些裂痕看起来像是文字。
descriptions.en: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.

sections.zh: 该星球的地表上有着巨大的裂痕，从其图案判断，不可能是自然形成的。从轨道上看，这些裂痕看起来像是文字。
sections.en: There is significant scarring on the surface of this world in a pattern that cannot be natural. From orbit, the massive rifts look almost like writing.

descriptions.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表探测到了微弱的信号。信号源似乎是某种追踪信标。
descriptions.en: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.

sections.zh: 我们在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表探测到了微弱的信号。信号源似乎是某种追踪信标。
sections.en: We are receiving a weak signal from the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. The source appears to be some kind of tracking beacon.

descriptions.zh: 我们在努力测绘这个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，结果在南半球发现了一条奇怪的山脉。它看上去不像是通过自然过程形成的。
descriptions.en: Efforts to map the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have identified a strange mountain range in the southern hemisphere. It does not appear to have formed naturally.

sections.zh: 我们在努力测绘这个[Root.GetPlanetMoon]的地表，结果在南半球发现了一条奇怪的山脉。它看上去不像是通过自然过程形成的。
sections.en: Efforts to map the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] have identified a strange mountain range in the southern hemisphere. It does not appear to have formed naturally.

descriptions.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表上一个小的矩形物体就像镜面一样反射各种探测射线。我们的探测器无法探测出其组成成分。
descriptions.en: A small rectangular object on the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is deflecting all scanning beams like a mirror. Our sensors are unable to determine its material composition.

sections.zh: [Root.GetPlanetMoon]地表上一个小的矩形物体就像镜面一样反射各种探测射线。我们的探测器无法探测出其组成成分。
sections.en: A small rectangular object on the surface of this [Root.GetPlanetMoon] is deflecting all scanning beams like a mirror. Our sensors are unable to determine its material composition.

descriptions.zh: 我们接收到这颗气态巨行星的大气内发射出来的微弱信号。可能是什么人，或者是什么东西正在试图建立联系？
descriptions.en: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?

sections.zh: 我们接收到这颗气态巨行星的大气内发射出来的微弱信号。可能是什么人，或者是什么东西正在试图建立联系？
sections.en: We are picking up what may be a faint transmission coming from somewhere deep inside the atmosphere of this gas giant. Could someone - or something - be trying to communicate?

descriptions.zh: 传感器显示，我们在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气内短暂探测到了一艘中型飞船。
descriptions.en: The sensor profile of a mid-sized vessel was briefly detected inside the upper atmosphere of this gas giant.

sections.zh: 传感器显示，我们在这颗气态巨行星的上层大气内短暂探测到了一艘中型飞船。
sections.en: The sensor profile of a mid-sized vessel was briefly detected inside the upper atmosphere of this gas giant.

descriptions.zh: 一颗环绕着此气态巨行星的小型卫星似乎很快就要撞上这个巨行星了。
descriptions.en: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.

sections.zh: 一颗环绕着此气态巨行星的小型卫星似乎很快就要撞上这个巨行星了。
sections.en: A small and otherwise insignificant moon orbiting this gas giant appears to be on a trajectory that will soon result in a collision with its primary.

descriptions.zh: 这个世界已经在使用核武的战争灰飞烟灭了。
descriptions.en: This world has been thoroughly ravaged in a nuclear war.

sections.zh: 这个世界已经在使用核武的战争灰飞烟灭了。
sections.en: This world has been thoroughly ravaged in a nuclear war.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一个巨大的撞击坑，这似乎不是自然形成的。
descriptions.en: A large impact crater has been discovered that does not seem to be a natural occurrence.

sections.zh: 我们发现了一个巨大的撞击坑，这似乎不是自然形成的。
sections.en: A large impact crater has been discovered that does not seem to be a natural occurrence.

descriptions.zh: 有迹象表明，[Root.GetName]曾是某个古代文明的家园。
descriptions.en: [Root.GetName] exhibits signs of once having been home to an ancient civilization.

sections.zh: 有迹象表明，[Root.GetName]曾是某个古代文明的家园。
sections.en: [Root.GetName] exhibits signs of once having been home to an ancient civilization.

descriptions.zh: 从[From.GetName]的底下洞穴中发出的意料之外的辐射。这会不会是什么东西发出的信号？
descriptions.en: Unexpected emissions are coming from the underground caves on [From.GetName]. Could these be a signal of some sort?

sections.zh: 从[From.GetName]的底下洞穴中发出的意料之外的辐射。这会不会是什么东西发出的信号？
sections.en: Unexpected emissions are coming from the underground caves on [From.GetName]. Could these be a signal of some sort?

descriptions.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
descriptions.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

sections.zh: 在太空中我们发现了一个严重损毁的双足机器人。我们尚不清楚它的能源，但我们可以从它的记忆体中获取一些信息。
sections.en: We have found a heavily damaged bipedal robot floating in space. We do not understand its energy source, but we may be able to retrieve information from its memory.

descriptions.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。但我们不确定它的推进系统如何工作。
descriptions.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship with an unusual design. We're not quite sure how its propulsion system works.

sections.zh: 我们找到了一艘设计独特的古代太空舰船的残骸。但我们不确定它的推进系统如何工作。
sections.en: We have found the wreckage of an archaic spaceship with an unusual design. We're not quite sure how its propulsion system works.

descriptions.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。
descriptions.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater.

sections.zh: 我们发现了一艘古老的外星人星舰，它被半掩埋在一个小行星撞击坑中间。
sections.en: We have discovered an ancient alien starship lying half-buried in an asteroid crater.
